title: Airbus H125
notice: Start and shutdown as they worked on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (checked live on 2026-11-26), with the sim's own checklist wording where it has one. The full checklist (pre-flight tests, hydraulic test, fire test) is longer: use the sim's checklist for it.
sources: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)
MSFS2024/minimalcache/fs24-asobo-aircraft-h125/minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak: CLUE.* (the sim's checklist wording; unencrypted archive)

topics.title: Start the engine
topics.summary: Battery, generator, rotor brake, starting selector, twist grip to FLIGHT.

topics.title: Shut down
topics.summary: Twist grip to IDLE, starting selector OFF with the guard down, rotor brake.

hs_ground.title: Where is the aircraft?
hs_ground.text: Is the aircraft on the ground?
hs_ground.help: The answer is filled in from the simulator when it can tell.

hs_power.title: Power

steps.text: Lower the collective all the way down.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.why: The switch has three positions: 1 is OFF, 2 is ON.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)
Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Release the rotor brake: push the lever fully forward.
Check that the fuel shut-off lever is forward.

hs_power.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26, and the sources named in each step

hs_start.title: Start

steps.text: Lift the guard of the starting selector and set the selector to ON. The engine starts by itself (FADEC).
Wait until the engine is stable at idle.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Set the twist grip to FLIGHT.
steps.why: The twist grip has two positions, IDLE and FLIGHT; the FADEC sets the fuel.

steps.text: Wait for the rotor to reach 100 %.
steps.why: It took about a minute from the start.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Switch the lights on as needed.

hs_start.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26, and the sources named in each step

hs_done.title: Running
hs_done.text: The engine runs in FLIGHT and the rotor turns at 100 %. Take off to a hover.

hs_air.title: Flying
hs_air.text: Do not start the engine in flight.

hd_ground.title: Where is the aircraft?
hd_ground.text: Is the aircraft on the ground?
hd_ground.help: The answer is filled in from the simulator when it can tell.

hd_steps.title: Shut down

steps.text: Lower the collective all the way down.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Set the twist grip to IDLE.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Lower the guard of the starting selector, then set the selector to OFF. The engine stops.
steps.why: The selector goes to OFF only with its guard down (checked).

steps.text: When the rotor has slowed down, apply the rotor brake.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Switch the generator and the battery off.
steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

hd_steps.source: Checked on the H125 in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26, and the sources named in each step

hd_done.title: Shut down
hd_done.text: The engine is stopped and the rotor braked.
